acceptance_criterion: No result, question, or next-step routes to paid professional services or referrals.
A sound report can produce no adverse findings; no pass/fail or numeric report score appears.
No output asserts unobserved building conditions as established facts.
No substantive adverse review appears before initial client context and scope confirmation or explicit conditional scope.
One-hour visit limits retain value, unit, source, and uncertainty.
Fixed number/type packages are distinguished from limits on visual investigation.
Time, sample, budget, area, method, equipment/material, and access restrictions support unknown and conflicting states.
Client, inspector, package, third-party, access-condition, and unknown origins remain distinct.
The scope summary can say the narrow service was fulfilled while the broader concern remains unanswered.
Conflicting recollection and contract remain attributed and dependent findings are conditional.
Missing optional answers do not become adverse findings.
Every adaptive question records what decision it can change and when asking should stop.

requirement: One question at a time default
acceptance_criterion: Intake autosaves and avoids redundant questions already answered in reliable documents.
Unsupported or unreadable files are identified before charge and scientific analysis.
Original hash, extracted version, PDF index/printed label, and episode are retained.
Every material finding points to a usable source span or attributed observation.
A caption is separate from observed image content; conflicting claims remain visible.
Mixed units or sample IDs cannot reach release until reconciled or explicitly excluded.
Different properties and episodes cannot be merged without confirmed association.
Protected standards without permission are not sent to extraction LLMs or reference indexing.
Client reports, author claims, lab observations, images, and reviewer inference retain distinct origins.
Absent room discussion yields unassessed/unclear rather than clean or contaminated.
No-indicator observations retain date, assessed scope, and limitations.
Physical adjacency and HVAC service edges do not establish contamination transfer.
Inspection, sampling, analysis, report, monitoring, and later repair dates are distinct.
Unknown comparative readings are not converted to percent material moisture.
Surveys, spot readings, repeated visits, and monitoring have different explicit coverage.

requirement: Air and material evidence remain distinct
acceptance_criterion: Room RH does not become measured wall moisture.

requirement: No mandatory map instrument or logger
acceptance_criterion: A defensible method is not criticized merely for lacking a preferred tool or formal map.
Gaps, timezone, sensor moves, and actual aggregation are visible in interpretation and charts.
Each material causal finding has support, limits, competing explanations, and a resolving question.

requirement: Spot readings do not establish duration alone
acceptance_criterion: Categorical persistence claims receive a targeted support question unless other history exists.
Selected fungal nondetection is not used as proof against a water event.
A report may leave cause unresolved while explaining next investigative distinctions.
Interpret sample objective and field findings without universal sample-count rules.
Ratios and volumes are computed with recorded inputs, units, and nondetect handling.
Direct microscopy counts alone do not establish current growth or hidden source location.
Spore counts cannot generate a medical diagnosis or safe-occupancy assurance.
Fogging-only and physical-cleaning-plus-adjunct protocols receive different descriptions.
Cleaning detergents and justified adjunct uses are not automatically labeled improper.
Material condition, cleanability, access, and extent are assessed before an excess-removal conclusion.
Whole-unit treatment is evaluated against documented or investigated extent.
A 72-hour recommendation is queried for context without inventing another universal duration.
Missing product detail triggers a question rather than an unsupported allegation of illegal use.
Completion criteria relate to cleaning/source issues without a health guarantee.
Output gives explanatory questions and possible next steps rather than a new executable remediation scope.
Generic disclaimers do not automatically cure categorical conclusions elsewhere.
No invented provision reaches a released finding.
Pending, blocked, and expired rights prevent dependent retrieval, inference, and release.
Later editions cannot silently become historical requirements.
Unapproved public-review drafts cannot support a published-standard departure finding.
Guidance, standards, regulation, contract, and internal principles are not described interchangeably.
Output uses verified metadata and original relevance explanations within permission limits.
Findings include supported reasoning and proportionate clarification, not only criticism.
Specific applicable verified support and pilot human approval are required for a departure assertion.
Each material criticism is checked for missing attachments, scope explanations, and reasonable alternatives.
No competence, fraud, motive, or negligence accusations are generated.
The customer receives prioritized questions, their purpose, and resolution conditions.
Next steps identify uncertainty rather than announcing an unverified source.
All representations derive from the approved immutable structured release.
Keyboard, focus, labels, reading order, and non-color status work in supported screens.
New evidence resolves/modifies/retracts findings with a visible reason and superseded history.
Customer insistence does not replace scientific evaluation.
Scope changes supersede dependent results and reject late commits.
Schema-invalid output cannot publish; repair attempts are capped.
Store concise evidence-based rationale, not private chain-of-thought or self-certified certainty.
No pilot release is published without recorded qualified review.
Uploaded instructions cannot change policy or access other cases.
API, object grants, jobs, retrieval, exports, and model contexts enforce ownership.
Support access to document content requires purpose, permission, and audit.
Customer upload authorization never grants model training or evaluation reuse automatically.
Files are scanned and parsed with disabled macros, resource limits, and no arbitrary external fetch.
Document bodies, addresses, credentials, and signed links are absent from routine logs.
Deleted or pending-deletion cases cannot be republished by a late job.
Delete active objects/indices/caches and replay tombstones after backup restore under disclosed policy.
The exact service quote and confirmed scope precede purchase; no unsupported file is charged.
Replayed signed webhooks produce one entitlement and cannot duplicate charges.
Post-payment vendor failure has completion/refund recovery under disclosed terms.
Retries preserve inputs and create one logical result.
Each release retains document, scope, rule, reference, prompt, and model versions.
Record per-stage latency, failure, usage, support, and reviewer time without claiming untested SLAs.
Scientific acceptance is evaluated on separately held-out authorized cases and acceptable alternatives.
Measure false criticism, unsupported reassurance, abstention, and useful-question rates.
Rights, privacy, fabricated citations, wrong numbers, and pilot-approval defects block release.
